title: Integration, Reproducibility, and Research-Release Prospective Protocol
objective: Determine whether the frozen AEGIS Research Core is internally consistent, reproducible, provenance-complete, scientifically bounded, and suitable to freeze as a research-release candidate before v1.0.

R1.name: repository_identity_and_cleanliness
R1.pass_rule: Exact parent/remote identity; tracked tree and index clean at audit entry; generated release records use explicit staging allowlists.

R2.name: frozen_evidence_provenance_completeness
R2.pass_rule: Tracked experiment records are inventoried with stable Git identities; frozen closure/protocol records required for the release lineage are present.

R3.name: environment_and_dependency_reproducibility
R3.pass_rule: Repository exposes sufficient tracked environment/dependency information to reconstruct the research software environment, or any gap is explicitly classified as a release blocker.

R4.name: command_and_workflow_reproducibility
R4.pass_rule: Established research workflows, runners, scripts, or documented commands needed to understand/reproduce frozen experiments are inventoried without rerunning scientific experiments.

R5.name: test_and_invariant_readiness
R5.pass_rule: Tracked test/invariant inventory is captured; only already-established non-scientific verification may be executed if Step2 can identify it without changing code or scientific results.

R6.name: architecture_and_component_documentation_consistency
R6.pass_rule: Tracked documentation and source structure permit an internally consistent research-core architecture/component inventory; discrepancies are blockers or explicit limitations.

R7.name: scientific_claim_and_limitation_consistency
R7.pass_rule: Release claims preserve frozen SUPPORTED/NOT_SUPPORTED/NOT_COMPUTED/NOT_AVAILABLE/PROHIBITED boundaries, including v0.35-v0.37 conclusions.

R8.name: artifact_and_release_manifest_completeness
R8.pass_rule: A release candidate can enumerate code, tests, experiment records, reproducibility metadata, scientific claims/limitations, and release notes without depending on untracked local artifacts.

R9.name: official_test_and_data_boundary
R9.pass_rule: Official-test access remains zero; no sealed/official test data are opened to construct the release.

R10.name: v1_readiness
R10.pass_rule: All mandatory R1-R9 gates PASS and no unresolved scientific-integrity, provenance, or reproducibility blocker remains.

blocker_policy.scientific_failure: Do not repair or reinterpret frozen scientific results in v0.38.
blocker_policy.reproducibility_or_integration_blocker: Freeze the blocker first. A later narrowly scoped corrective step may be authorized only if it is non-scientific and does not alter model behavior or frozen results.
blocker_policy.missing_optional_material: Record as limitation if it does not prevent R1-R10 satisfaction.

release_candidate_required_outputs: integrated scientific claim and limitation ledger

v1_policy.v1_meaning: A reproducible research-core freeze of the scientifically bounded repository; not a claim of production deployment readiness.
